files.records_in_its_return: model {name: 'opus', effort: 'high'} only; tools/sota-convergence/claude_lane.py writes <work-dir>/claude/<catalog>__<layer_id>.json from the workflow result and adds model.family 'anthropic', the resolved model name (--resolved-model, for example claude-opus-5-5 from child-usage.mjs) and provenance {workflow_path, workflow_sha256, agentlab_commit}, refusing workflow bytes that are uncommitted or differ from this SHA256SUMS entry

scope: Workflow files vendored byte for byte from agent-lab so a host holding only this catalog can rerun the layer-verdict Claude lane (2026-09-23 peer audit). tools/sota-convergence/record_verdicts.py accepts a new-wave Claude lane return only when its provenance.workflow_sha256 equals this directory's SHA256SUMS entry for the named workflow. The lane prompt it fills is tools/sota-convergence/lane-prompt.md, already in this catalog.
